_approach: Synthetic toms on the 16th before beats 2 and 4 (mid) and the last 16th of beats 2 and 4 (high) give a eurodance bounce around the clap; bar 2 adds a mid-tom double and a low tom on the final offbeat. Offbeat open hats, quiet 16th closed hats. Reference: Luca-Dante Spadafora & Niklas Dee & Octavian, Bassjackers' techno edits. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
